format.mode: Asynchronous 1v1 vs another player's character. Attacker plays live (manual or auto); the defender is the AI-controlled snapshot of the opponent's arena-defense preset.

items.rule: Attack and defense each use their own preset number (11/27/2025); replaced on 12/18 by per-content 'dungeon presets' (skill, companion, ability, artifact, equipment presets per content).
Defender = stored snapshot. Players report defense fights using an older setup than their current one.
The PvP damage-reduction term uses stats taken before the fight; buffs/active skills/on-start effects in the fight do not change it.
Attacker can play manually (move/jump, skill timing) or Full Auto; replays are recorded and shareable.

Quick battle (빠른 전투): available when attacker CP >= 5x defender CP. Uses the same auto-battle logic on the current attack/defense presets; not a guaranteed win. Same ticket use, rewards, ranking, record and replay.
Battle speed x1 / x1.5 / x2 (remembered between fights).
Leaving right after start counts as a normal loss. Disconnecting while entering also counts as a loss.
Win = reduce the opponent to 0 HP. Running out of time is a loss for the attacker (reported for Colosseum).

Time limit: NOT FOUND. A community model assumed about 15 s per Arena fight and 30 s per Colosseum fight (typical length, not a cap). After 4/30, Arena fights at high CP got longer; at low CP after unlock, shorter.

Companions fight: the main companion is summoned in battle (auto-summon On/Off is stored per dungeon preset since 7/2). Defender companions act too (Dark Knight basic-attack immunity + heal, Hero shield/stun).
Potions work but their effect is reduced in Arena/Colosseum.
Boss Monster Damage and Normal Monster Damage do not apply (players are neither). From 10/15 the PvP CP formula also excludes them and basic-attack target count.

Accuracy vs Evasion decides MISS; Critical Resistance lowers the attacker's crit rate; Debuff Tolerance matters. PvP CP weights Accuracy, Evasion, Damage Taken Decrease, Crit Resist, Debuff Tolerance higher than PvE CP (10/15).

Arena-only effects exist: artifact Soul Pouch (영혼의 주머니) '[Arena] Final Damage +20/24/28/32/36/40%' (also World Arena). Two passive skills (ids 808360, 808470, names unknown) give Final Damage +20% outside Arena and +40% in Arena.
Friendly duel (결투장 친선전): from a player's profile, unranked, no ticket; can be refused in settings; records/replays kept since 12/18.

damage_formula.per_mille_note: All % stats are per-mille internally: multiplier = (1000 + stat)/1000; e.g. Damage Taken Decrease 30% -> 300 -> (1000+300) in the (100% + DTD%) term.
damage_formula.who: In the base-damage part, offensive stats come from the attacker and defensive stats from the target. In the PvP reduction divisor, BOTH offensive and defensive stats are the TARGET's, taken before the fight.
formula_kr_verbatim: × 받는 피해 증가% × (100% − 받는 피해 감소%)
× (기본 공격 데미지% 또는 스킬 데미지%) × 스탯 비례 데미지%
× 크리티컬 발생 시 크리티컬 데미지% × (최소 데미지 배율% ~ 최대 데미지 배율%)
× 상태이상의 적에게 상태이상 데미지% × 최종 데미지% )
× 결투장 보정으로 레벨에 의한 피해량 감소% x 2
÷ ((( 공격력 × 방어 관통력% × 데미지% × 데미지 증폭%
× 스탯 비례 데미지% × ( 크리티컬 데미지 × 크리티컬 확률의 비중(최대 100%) )%
× ( 최소 데미지 배율 + 최대 데미지 배율 ) ÷ 2

content_constant.note: World Arena constant = 0.8 x Arena constant (WA deals/receives 80% of Arena damage).

level_penalty.note: '결투장 보정으로 레벨에 의한 피해량 감소% x 2'. Per +1 character level, final damage is multiplied relative to the previous level by:
level_penalty.open_question: Whose level (attacker, target or both) and how 'x 2' combines are not stated. The global wiki says 'the damage taken by the character also decreases proportionally to the character level' (target).

history.note: sqrt-based reduction (base damage was square-rooted); the same sqrt is also used in Boss Raid, Party Quest, Guild Training per NXKR_NT_0622.

history.formula_tail_kr: ... x 결투장 레벨 보정 x [콘텐츠 전용 상수: 아레나 10,000 / 콜로세움 6,000] x 최대 HP ÷ √(공격력 × 방어 관통력% × 데미지% × 데미지 증폭% × ((기본 공격 데미지 + 스킬 데미지)÷2)% × 스탯 비례 데미지% × (크리티컬 데미지 × 크리티컬 확률의 비중)% × (최소+최대 데미지 배율)÷2 × 최종 데미지%) ÷ 1,000,000
history.bug: Max HP multiplied the damage taken, so HP gave no survival; offensive stats reduced incoming damage. Compensations were paid.

cap.note: natural refill stops at 20; the cap is not shown in the UI

red_diamond_purchase.value: When at 0 tickets, tickets can be bought with 레드 다이아; community: 15 tickets per day for 1,000 RD in total (= 7,000 RD per week). Posts talk of up to 5 refills per day.
red_diamond_purchase.per_refill_price: NOT FOUND (a 5 x 3-ticket ladder summing to 1,000 is plausible but unconfirmed)
red_diamond_purchase.daily_limit: official: a maximum number of extra charges exists ('아레나 추가 충전 최대 횟수', bug fix 9/22)

tickets.consumed: 1 ticket per attack, regardless of result (also for quick battle).
tickets.compensation_example: 3 arena tickets were mailed as compensation on 2025-11-27 (NXKR_NT_1127B).

refresh.paid: 150 레드 다이아 per refresh after free ones

opponent_list.selection: Opponents with similar ranking score appear ('추천 상대'). Dropping your score through lost defenses makes weaker opponents show up.
opponent_list.selection_conf: community (World Arena rule is official: '유사한 랭킹 점수를 가진 상대방')

attack_win.value: about +20 base, scaled by CP ratio: +31 or +42 seen vs the same opponent; doubling own arena CP halved the gain

attack_loss.value: NOT FOUND (a 7/2 bug turned some wins into losses; players then saw points drop)

start_and_reset.value: Ranking points reset at every weekly settlement (Monday 00:00; a player confirms a reset at Monday midnight 2025-12-22). Start value NOT FOUND for Arena (World Arena and Colosseum start at 1,000).

observed_top_scores.value: server #1 around 5,870-6,000 at week end; #2 about 80 behind #1 on one server

score.inference: If start = 1,000 and a win is about +20, ~245 wins/week (35 tickets/day x 7) gives ~5,900, matching the observed top scores. INFERENCE ONLY.

tiers.note_divisions: Only 'Diamond/Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze 1' appear in reward tables; whether 2-5 divisions exist below Master is NOT FOUND.
tiers.assignment: Reward tier is decided at settlement by position on the server ranking: a player at ranking #1 was shown as 챔피언1 (DC111613), and players talk of cut-offs at rank 1,000 / 2,000 (DC150494). World Arena publishes rank ranges for the same tier names (see world_arena.individual_rewards); Arena's own ranges are NOT FOUND.
tiers.max_tier_tracking: A 'highest tier reached' value exists: 아레나 랭커 유물 핫딜 unlocks at '아레나 최고 티어 그랜드마스터5 이상'; newbie missions require reaching 아레나 플래티넘 / 다이아몬드 / 마스터.
tiers.promotion_reward: Community mentions '아레나 승급보상' worth arena coins (one player lost 2 of them = 4,000 coins). Amounts NOT FOUND.

settlement.tz: server time (KR: KST UTC+9; global: Skania UTC+9, Aria/Aquila UTC+8, Luna UTC+1, Bera UTC-8)
settlement.note: Daily reward needs at least one arena battle that day (community)

per_battle_coins.note: Not re-checked after the 9/22 reward increase.

world_arena.status: Ran 3 rounds in July 2026 (KR and global). No later rounds found up to 2026-11-24.

unlock.value: Chapter 16 boss clear; can join a running round if cleared mid-round; guild not required

world_arena.scope: All servers of the same region (동일 지역 내 서버 전체).

tickets.buy: 3 tickets per purchase with 레드 다이아; price rises 100 -> 500 by daily purchase count, then stays 500

world_arena.matching: Opponents with similar ranking score; list can be refreshed (cost NOT FOUND). Pick 1 opponent.
world_arena.artifact_block: Before the fight, choose 1 of the defender's equipped artifacts whose special effect is disabled.

combat_mods.damage: same formula, constant 5,764,800,000 = 80% of Arena dealt and received
combat_mods.potion: potion effect reduced; final recovery ends up equal to Arena/Colosseum (verbatim: '물약의 효과가 감소되어 적용됩니다. 회복 효과 감소의 결과로 아레나/콜로세움과 최종 회복량은 동일합니다.')
combat_mods.immunity: damage immunity and basic-attack-damage immunity durations x0.5

score.change: Gain/loss scaled by the DEFENDER's World Arena preset CP at match time; higher defender CP -> bigger swings for both attack and defense.
score.below_1000: a loss (attack or defense) that would go to/below 1,000 costs a fixed 10 points
score.defense_cap: max 5 defense-success scores from the same opponent per round
score.top5: Each day the 5 highest-CP opponents you beat are recorded (re-beat at higher CP updates the entry); confirmed at 00:00; scores from TOP5 wins get a multiplier.

world_arena.guild: Guild score = sum of members' scores; joining after the round starts: can play but score not added and no guild reward; leaving mid-round removes you from guild score and reward. Rewards need >= 1 attack or defense.

table.extra: 월드 아레나 의자: 골드 [7일 기간제, 경험치 획득량 +10%]

guild_rewards.booster_note: 7-day '월드 아레나 길드 랭킹 통합 N위 혜택' EXP booster; 브론즈1 gets none

world_arena.chair: World Arena chairs (rank 1-3): 7-day, owned effect EXP +10%; giving fame to a seated player grants the giver EXP +10% for 30 min once per day.
world_arena.abuse_rules: Throwing fights to guildmates (no attack skills/artifacts) to feed TOP5 was punished (24 accounts, 3-day ban, cubes taken back).

colosseum.type: Event content, 3 rounds per batch; group of 25 players from all servers of the region with similar strength; each fights the other 24 one-on-one.
colosseum.unlock: Arena must be unlocked when matching runs; if Arena unlocks mid-round you join from the next round.
colosseum.matching: By personal highest CP across presets (community; devs said no plan to change). 5/21: 'similar strength' criterion changed so deliberately low ranking CP no longer helps.
colosseum.skill_ban: Before attacking, ban 1 skill from a fixed list of the opponent's skills (list can include passives).
colosseum.bingo: Beating an opponent activates their cell on a bingo board; losing a defense deactivates the cell. First defense loss on a neutral cell costs no points. Completed-line rewards are paid instantly, once per line, and kept even if cells are later lost.

community_breakdown_2026_10.note: 24 cells x 100 + 1000 = 3,400 for a full board

daily_bonus_history.value: +10 per beaten opponent at 00:00; none on the last day

colosseum.time_and_damage: Colosseum constant 4,323,600,000 (60% of Arena); stronger per-level penalty above 70. 4/30: damage at high CP raised (shorter fights).

rank_rewards_global_wiki.kr_check: KR player got 80 for a round (DC230233), matching rank 1.
rank_rewards_global_wiki.condition: paid only with a participation record

bingo_rewards_global_wiki.history: Community says line rewards were cut on the 2026-03-24 round (previously 7 SF per line?); 'all bingo = 20 SF' in 2026-09.

colosseum.board_shape: NOT FOUND (25 players; up to 8 line rewards)
colosseum.tickets: NOT FOUND (community suggests unlimited attacks; '빠른 도전')

길드 대항전 (Guild War, global 'Guild War: Dr.summary: 5 guilds of similar strength per group; members fight a BOSS for score; weekly Thu 12:00 -> next Mon 22:00 (KR). Until 5/21 rank->points; from 9/3 top-29 point values raised.
길드 대항전 (Guild War, global 'Guild War: Dr.rewards_global_wiki_conflict: wiki says rank 1 = +16% EXP and +16% Meso, 7 days; KR note says +13% meso, buff until next Monday 21:59

길드 보스 대전.summary: Guild vs guild 1:1 matched; from 5/21 the guild with higher total boss damage wins. Seasons of 3 rounds (Fri 12:00 -> Wed 21:59).
